headline: Sinopec Nine-Month Refining Profit Rises Fourfold to $4.2 Billion
summary: Sinopec reported that its refining profit rose about fourfold year-on-year to 30.1 billion yuan ($4.2 billion) in the first nine months of 2026 despite a 10% fall in runs.

impacts.name: Sinopec
impacts.why: Significant year-on-year growth in refining segment profits enhances corporate earnings performance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Substantial profit expansion in core processing operations bolstered investor expectations regarding the energy corporation's earnings capacity.
